entities.name: UPDATE-NEEDED state
entities.description: A UE state where radio capability update is needed, restricting certain UE activities until barring is alleviated.

entities.name: User data transmission restriction
entities.description: UE shall not send any user data while in UPDATE-NEEDED state.

entities.name: Signalling restriction with exceptions
entities.description: UE shall not send signalling information except for service request response to paging, emergency services, or emergency services fallback.

entities.name: Cell selection/reselection
entities.description: UE shall perform cell selection/reselection while in UPDATE-NEEDED state.

entities.name: Barring alleviation condition
entities.description: Condition where lower layers indicate barring is alleviated for the access category associated with registration procedure.

entities.name: eCall inactivity procedure
entities.description: Procedure performed when UE is configured for eCall only mode at expiry of timer T3444 or T3445.

entities.name: Timer T3444
entities.description: Timer used in eCall only mode configuration, expiry triggers eCall inactivity procedure.

entities.name: Timer T3445
entities.description: Timer used in eCall only mode configuration, expiry triggers eCall inactivity procedure.

relations.description: UPDATE-NEEDED state establishes restriction on user data transmission.
UPDATE-NEEDED state establishes signalling restrictions with specific exceptions.
UPDATE-NEEDED state includes cell selection/reselection as a required procedure.
Barring alleviation condition guards the transition out of UPDATE-NEEDED state.
Expiry of timer T3444 starts the eCall inactivity procedure.
Expiry of timer T3445 starts the eCall inactivity procedure.
